menu "Power management"

config PM
	bool "Power management"
	help
	  Enable power management. This option enables the power management
	  subsystem.

if PM

config PM_DEVICE
	bool "Device Power Management"
	help
	  Enable device power management. This option enables power management
	  for devices. Devices will be suspended when system goes to sleep.
	  They will be resumed when system wakes up.

config PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME
	bool "Device runtime Power Management"
	depends on PM_DEVICE
	help
	  Enable device runtime power management. This option enables power
	  management for devices at runtime.

config PM_CPU_OPS_ON_IDLE
	bool "Enable CPU power management based on idle"
	help
	  Enable power management operations that will be done when the system
	  is idle. This is where the system will enter into one of the
	  supported sleep states.

config PM_SLEEP_STATES
	bool "Enable sleep states"
	depends on PM_CPU_OPS_ON_IDLE
	help
	  Enable power management sleep states. This option allows to put the
	  system into one of the available sleep states when going idle.

if PM_SLEEP_STATES

config PM_DEEP_SLEEP_STATES
	bool "Enable deep sleep states"
	help
	  Enable power management deep sleep states. This option allows to put
	  the system into one of the available deep sleep states when going
	  idle. This is a more involved sleep state where the kernel does not
	  keep track of timing. The system is expected to be woken up by an
	  interrupt.

endif # PM_SLEEP_STATES

config PM_MIN_RESIDENCY_DEFAULT
	int "Default minimum residency for CPU states"
	default 0
	help
	  Default minimum residency in microseconds for CPU power states.
	  A power state is only entered if the time to the next kernel timer
	  event is longer than its minimum residency. This value can be
	  overwritten by the SoC.

config PM_POLICY_CUSTOM
	bool "Custom power management policy"
	help
	  When this option is enabled, the default power management policy is
	  not built. The application is then expected to provide its own
	  power management policy.

if !PM_POLICY_CUSTOM

choice
	prompt "Power management policy"
	default PM_POLICY_RESIDENCY

config PM_POLICY_RESIDENCY
	bool "Residency based power management policy"
	help
	  This policy looks at the residency time of the available power
	  states and chooses the one that best fits the duration of the
	  upcoming idle period.

config PM_POLICY_APP
	bool "Application-specific power management policy"
	help
	  This policy allows the application to be notified of the upcoming
	  idle duration and decide if the system should enter a sleep state.

config PM_POLICY_DUMMY
	bool "Dummy power management policy"
	help
	  This option enables a dummy power management policy. This is useful
	  on platforms that want to enable power management but do not have
	  a policy yet.

endchoice

endif # !PM_POLICY_CUSTOM

endif # PM

endmenu
